query:
SELECT mp.id, mp.userId, mp.university, mp.major, mp.field, mp.region, 
       mp.isActive, mp.verificationStatus
FROM mentor_profiles mp
WHERE mp.isActive = true AND mp.verificationStatus = 'approved';
